name: VVV
description:
About This Game

Raise your Voltage in a Virtual world and seize Victory!!!

Game Overview

VVV is a roguelite action game where you dash through multiple stages, choosing enhancements to grow your character after each clear.

The concept is to experience the long-term growth of an RPG in a single play cycle.

Losing HP does not cause a game over, allowing you to focus entirely on your offensive strategy and damage output.

—With every run starting from zero, make your choices and craft the perfect combo.

Arts Combo System

Seamlessly cancel and chain multiple Arts to build your combos.

As you stack enhancements that increase damage based on hit counts and links, you might even take down powerful enemies in a single blow!

Reward System

The rewards you earn by clearing stages will determine the direction of your play.

Choose rewards that match your playstyle and aim for your ideal build!

Voltage — The Key to Strategy

Increasing your Voltage boosts the damage dealt to enemies.

Voltage can be raised through various means, including activating Arts and obtaining rewards.

VictoryArts — Your Trump Card

By obtaining specific rewards, you can learn VictoryArts.

These ultimate moves, triggered by filling a gauge, can be saved for bosses or used to sweep through enemies. The possibilities are infinite.

Virtual Vigor (VV) — The Energy of Action

Virtual Vigor is the resource consumed every time you use an Art.

It recovers automatically, so you can unleash your favorite combos without worrying about running dry.

By extending the maximum Vigor or recovery speed through rewards, your playstyle will evolve significantly.

Time Pressure

Your remaining time for all stages decreases in real-time. Will you extend your time with rewards or power up to clear stages faster? The choice is yours. Fight until the very last second.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

VVV Streaming & Video Guidelines

Thank you for your interest in this title.
Our guidelines for streaming and video posting are as follows.

■ About Streaming and Video Posting
You are free to stream or post videos of this game, with or without monetization.
Both individuals and corporations are welcome to enjoy it freely.

■ Required Items

When streaming or posting videos, please be sure to follow the items below.

① Description Field
Please clearly state the following information in the description of your video or stream.

  • Game title: "VVV"

  • URL of the Steam store page

② In-Stream Announcement
During your stream, please feel free to make the following announcement (optional, but appreciated!).
"The store page for "VVV" is now live! Viewers, please head to the store page from the description and add it to your wishlist!!!!!!"
*This may be done at any point during the stream.

③ Rights to Materials Used
For any VRM models or image materials used in the game, please be sure to comply with the following.

  • The materials must be ones for which the streamer holds the rights

  • Or, permission for use must be properly confirmed and obtained

■ Disclaimer

The developer assumes no responsibility whatsoever for any troubles arising in connection with the streaming or video posting of this game.

■ Notes

・The contents of these guidelines are subject to change without prior notice.

・Please refrain from any use that goes against public order and morals.
